---
name: Defect
about: Something behaves wrongly, and the cause is known
---

### Observed

<!-- What happens, and what should happen instead. -->

### Location

<!-- Where it lives: files, functions or entry points, as paths from the repository root. -->

### Cause

<!-- The mechanism that produces what is observed. If the cause is not known, file an inquiry instead and link its answer here. -->

### Impact

<!-- Who or what is affected, and the conditions that trigger it. -->

### Approach

<!-- The change intended. A choice still to be made belongs in an inquiry, not here. -->

### Deliverables

<!-- Artifacts this issue produces, one per line: `path or URL` - what it is. -->

- [ ] 

### Actionables

<!-- Steps that leave no artifact of their own. A defect that has not been reproduced opens with the step that reproduces it, by the method its test will use. Write "None." when every step is a deliverable. -->

- [ ] 

### Criteria

<!-- Statements that are either true or false once the work is done. -->

- [ ] 

### Verification

<!-- The command or steps that check the criteria. -->
